hypothesis: Add one acquisition mechanism on top of the unchanged graph GA: at each suggestion round, overgenerate a bounded pool of fresh canonical graph offspring, fit task-local Gaussian-process predictors with complementary fixed molecular-fingerprint Tanimoto kernels using only oracle-evaluated molecules, and submit the pool members with the highest ensemble expected improvement over the best observed score.
method_name: De novo molecular graph genetic algorithm
method_thesis: Maintain an elite population seeded only by the fixed evaluated initial molecules, select parents using their observed ranks, and generate every new proposal de novo through chemically sanitized molecular-graph crossover and mutation. This training-free evolutionary loop converts feedback into selection pressure immediately, avoiding a learned model's cold start within the 300-call budget while never ranking or enumerating a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: rank-biased parent selection with elitist population replacement
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: stochastic graph crossover and mutation of evaluated parents

applicability_conditions: The Parent graph operators continue to produce substantially more canonical novel candidates than the announced batch within the bounded local-attempt allowance.
Oracle feedback contains non-tied finite scores and at least one fixed molecular fingerprint supplies task-local similarity that is informative about nearby reward.
Useful improvements are present among graph edits reachable from the evaluated population, so acquisition is prioritizing a relevant candidate pool rather than compensating for missing chemistry.

The mechanism may not transfer when the objective is discontinuous or aliased under every chosen fingerprint, when posterior uncertainty dominates all mean differences, or when graph-operator yield is too low to overgenerate beyond one batch.
Regularization and the bounded deterministic fallback must keep every round numerically stable and able to fill the protocol-announced batch offline.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if rounds with a sufficiently large pool and finite non-tied ensemble expected-improvement values do not emit exactly the highest-ranked available candidates, or if their aggregate submitted-minus-pool expected-improvement lift is non-positive; either observation would show that the surrogate acquisition did not move proposal allocation away from the Parent's unprioritized valid-offspring stream.
research_intent.implementation_change: Preserve the Parent's bounded oracle-evaluated population, rank-biased parent selection, graph crossover and mutation portfolio, elitist replacement, and novelty filters. Change only suggestion acquisition: retain provenance while constructing a bounded overcomplete pool, featurize the evaluated set and pool with fixed complementary RDKit fingerprints, fit regularized exact kernel predictors to all finite accepted scores, combine their posterior moments into one expected-improvement value per pool member, and emit the evaluator-announced batch in descending expected-improvement order. If there are too few distinct observations, a predictor is numerically unusable, or scores or acquisition values are tied, use a bounded deterministic fallback over that same already-canonical pool; never alter the announced batch size or submit a duplicate or invalid molecule.
research_intent.mechanism: Add one acquisition mechanism on top of the unchanged graph GA: at each suggestion round, overgenerate a bounded pool of fresh canonical graph offspring, fit task-local Gaussian-process predictors with complementary fixed molecular-fingerprint Tanimoto kernels using only oracle-evaluated molecules, and submit the pool members with the highest ensemble expected improvement over the best observed score.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-5a4d65146dd1 already turns feedback into positive score-rank parent pressure, retains every eligible elite, and constructs 1,450 valid novel offspring from only 1,523 graph-operator attempts, but it submits each offspring as soon as it is constructed and therefore has no within-round utility discrimination among the many valid local edits it could make. That unprioritized use of oracle calls coincides with only 0.022050 terminal Top-1 improvement and 0.182817 AUC on median_2, plus 0.138748 AUC on sitagliptin_mpo, despite completing all 290 adaptive evaluations on each task.
research_intent.revisit_rationale: Cluster c-a3ba0c6fb3 was Knowledge-only when n-895bba5eb944 coupled fingerprint-GP acquisition to posterior-tilted sampling from a corpus-trained VAE. This case has a materially changed Parent mechanism stack: n-5a4d65146dd1 supplies confirmed score-rank-elitist search directly around oracle-evaluated graphs, with 0.952068 novel-valid local yield and a much stronger 0.470772 seed-0 macro mean. The Child reuses only surrogate expected-improvement preselection over that productive local graph pool, not the earlier latent generator or posterior tilt, so it tests whether the acquisition mechanism transfers when candidate support is anchored in the Parent's evaluated neighborhoods.

applicability_conditions: Operational activation is now supported across all three Search Seeds under the frozen 300-call, batch-10 Hard-Five protocol: all 435 rounds emitted exactly ten top-ranked candidates, all 1,305 fingerprint fits succeeded without added jitter, no fallback occurred, and every task session completed with zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

The mechanism is supported when the inherited graph operators can overgenerate well beyond the announced batch: every observed round produced exactly 80 eligible canonical novel candidates before the bounded attempt limit, giving an eightfold pool for selection.

Task-local fitting is supported when oracle observations remain finite and sufficiently non-tied: training sizes advanced from 10 through 290, every round had at least 10 distinct scores, and all three complementary fingerprint predictors remained numerically usable.

Expected-improvement ranking is supported when the selected boundary is discriminable: every round selected ranks 1 through 10, all 435 signed lifts were positive, and no round tied acquisition ranks 10 and 11. The evidence does not establish the same pressure if all acquisition values tie or numerical fallback is required.

The result establishes reproducible proposal-allocation movement, not surrogate calibration or separate downstream score contribution. Direct algorithmic-Parent telemetry is available only for seed 0; seeds 1 and 2 replicate activation against the exact registered no-ranking reference of 0.0 rather than paired algorithmic-Parent runs.

Transfer is not established when useful chemistry lies outside graph edits reachable from the inherited population, graph-operator yield cannot form an overcomplete pool, scores are tied or nonfinite, every fingerprint predictor is unusable, or the objective is discontinuous or aliased under all chosen fingerprints.

observable_measurements.parent_value: The replication Parent is this node's existing seed-0 record: all 145/145 rounds constructed 80-member pools, submitted exactly acquisition ranks 1 through 10, completed all 435 fingerprint fits without jitter or fallback, and produced positive signed lift in every round. Its submitted-batch mean expected improvement was 0.003988695962614932 versus pool mean 0.002040724025575207, giving mean lift 0.0019479719370397238 and summed lift 0.28245593087075993. The node's algorithmic Parent n-5a4d65146dd1 has no surrogate, overcomplete-pool acquisition ranking, or multi_fingerprint_expected_improvement_selection event and submits the valid-offspring stream as constructed, so the pre-registered no-surrogate, no-pool-ranking signed-lift reference is 0.0. The two new replicas reproduce the established positive direction rather than relying on seed 0 alone.
observable_measurements.value: Both added Search Seeds reproduced the predicted acquisition-allocation increase. Across seeds 1 and 2, all 290/290 suggestion rounds constructed an eligible pool of 80 canonical novel graph offspring and submitted 10, retaining 23,200 candidate expected-improvement records. Training-set size advanced from 10 to 290 in steps of 10, with at least 10 distinct finite scores in every round. All 870 fingerprint fits (Morgan radius 2, RDKit path, and atom pair) reported status ok with zero added jitter, and no round used a fallback. All 23,200 candidate expected-improvement values were finite and pairwise distinct within their round. Every submitted batch was exactly acquisition ranks 1 through 10, so submitted_top_acquisition_fraction was 1.0 in all 290 rounds; the 2,900 selected identities also matched the graph-generation receipts and evaluator trajectories exactly and in order. Recomputing the selected mean, pool mean, and signed lift from every candidate row gave maximum absolute residual 2.6020852139652106e-18. Across the new replicas, submitted-batch mean expected improvement was 0.0032308971980972785 versus complete-pool mean 0.0015305077833438865, giving arithmetic mean signed lift 0.0017003894147533923 and summed lift 0.4931129302784837; all 290 lifts were positive and ranged from 0.000053637413751227766 to 0.008190978901596955. Seed-level mean lifts were 0.0016324590494533077 for seed 1 and 0.0017683197800534764 for seed 2, each positive in 145/145 rounds. Pooling the new replicas with seed 0 gives 435/435 positive lifts, submitted-batch mean expected improvement 0.0034834967862698283 versus pool mean 0.0017005798640876606, mean signed lift 0.0017829169221821677, summed lift 0.7755688611492433, and range 0.00002225321904728214 to 0.008446514965245488. Three-seed task-level mean lifts, each positive in 87/87 rounds, were deco_hop 0.0016610227025976084, drd2_docking 0.002878207837804423, median_2 0.0008171091696796652, sitagliptin_mpo 0.0015075405121424323, and zaleplon_mpo 0.00205070438868671. Two inherited seed-0 drd2_docking pools contained exact zero ties only below the selected boundary; none of the 435 rounds had a rank-10/rank-11 tie or failed to select the top ten.

possible_failure_causes: The registered lift measures discrimination under the ensemble's own expected-improvement values. Exact top-ten selection and positive lift establish that acquisition changed proposal allocation, but do not establish posterior calibration or that fingerprint-local predicted improvement yields higher true oracle reward.

Acquisition pressure is positive but uneven across objectives: the three-seed mean lift on median_2 is 0.0008171091696796652, and the smallest pooled round lift is 0.00002225321904728214. Objectives aliased or discontinuous under all three fingerprints could therefore leave the mechanism operational while offering weak useful discrimination.

Two inherited seed-0 drd2_docking pools have exact expected-improvement ties at zero among unselected ranks 77 through 80. These ties did not touch the top-ten boundary or trigger the falsifier, but broader or boundary-level ties could force the deterministic fallback and remove acquisition pressure.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the inherited graph operators can overgenerate well beyond the announced batch: every one of the 145 seed-0 rounds produced 80 eligible canonical novel candidates for a batch of 10 before the bounded attempt limit.

Supported under the 300-call, batch-10 protocol with this regularization and deterministic fallback contract: no fallback was needed, every round emitted exactly 10 candidates, and all five evaluator sessions completed with zero invalid or duplicate attempts.

The activation evidence establishes that ensemble EI changed proposal allocation, with exact top-10 selection and positive signed lift on all five objectives; it does not by itself establish posterior calibration or that fingerprint-local predicted improvement translates to better oracle reward on objectives aliased or discontinuous under these fingerprints.
